description: Read buffered console messages, uncaught exceptions and browser log entries from an attached page. Requires attach first; only entries captured since attach (plus what attach replayed) are available. Returns the most recent matching entries. Pass since_seq from a previous call to get only new entries.

exclude_keywords.description: Drop entries whose text or location contains any of these (case-insensitive), e.g. ["google-analytics", "doubleclick"]

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match on message text and location

since_seq.description: Only entries with seq greater than this

target_id.description: Defaults to the most recently attached page

name: get_console
title: Read console output
